description: This file defines a CMake script that implements a depth-first traversal (DFS) callback mechanism for parsing nested map and list data structures. It emits events based on the structure of the data, such as list or map beginning and end, and handles references and nested structures, enabling a callback to process or analyze data during traversal.

methods.name: dfs_callback
methods.description: Main function that initiates a depth-first traversal of a nested map/list structure, calling a user-provided callback with various events representing structure and content.
